title: 雅思·城市与交通精选 · 64 句
description: 围绕本主题练习论点、理由、条件、让步与政策评价；中英对照及逐题讲解，难度 3–5。

items.zh: 缩短公交候车时间，可能比单纯降低票价更能鼓励通勤者放弃开车。
items.en: Reducing bus waiting times may encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home than lowering fares alone.
answers: Reducing bus waiting times may encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home than lowering fares alone.
items.notes: 两个动名词短语比较措施；leave their cars at home 表示选择不开车，alone 限定单一措施。

items.zh: 如果新住宅远离就业中心，较低的房价就可能被较高的通勤成本抵消。
items.en: If new homes are far from employment centres, lower house prices may be offset by higher commuting costs.
answers: If new homes are far from employment centres, lower house prices may be offset by higher commuting costs.
items.notes: be offset by 表示被抵消；用住房和交通的联动避免单一指标判断。

items.zh: 虽然拓宽道路能暂时缓解拥堵，新增车流却可能很快占满这些空间。
items.en: Although wider roads can temporarily ease congestion, additional traffic may soon fill the extra space.
answers: Although wider roads can temporarily ease congestion, additional traffic may soon fill the extra space.
items.notes: although 引出短期收益；temporarily 与 soon 对照时间尺度。

items.zh: 适合步行的社区需要安全的路口，而不只是整洁的人行道。
items.en: Walkable neighbourhoods need safe crossings, not just well-maintained pavements.
answers: Walkable neighbourhoods need safe crossings, not just well-maintained pavements.
items.notes: not just 限定条件的充分性；well-maintained 表示维护良好的。

items.zh: 靠近车站的土地，应优先用于高密度住宅和日常服务设施。
items.en: Land near stations should be prioritised for high-density housing and everyday amenities.
answers: Land near stations should be prioritised for high-density housing and everyday amenities.
items.notes: 被动语态聚焦土地用途；amenities 指便于日常生活的设施。

items.zh: 只有当末班车足够晚时，夜班员工才能真正受益于公共交通。
items.en: Only if the last bus runs late enough can night-shift workers fully benefit from public transport.
answers: Only if the last bus runs late enough can night-shift workers fully benefit from public transport.
items.notes: only if 前置引起 can 倒装；benefit from 表示从中受益。

items.zh: 与其把空置楼宇全部拆除，不如评估哪些建筑可以改作住宅。
items.en: Rather than demolish all vacant buildings, planners should assess which ones could be converted into housing.
answers: Rather than demolish all vacant buildings, planners should assess which ones could be converted into housing.
items.notes: rather than 后接原形；be converted into 表示被改造为。

items.zh: 沿街种树可以提供遮阴，从而让炎热天气下的步行更舒适。
items.en: Planting trees along streets provides shade, making walking more comfortable in hot weather.
answers: Planting trees along streets provides shade, making walking more comfortable in hot weather.
items.notes: making 引导结果状语；make + 宾语 + 形容词说明作用。

items.zh: 住在交通不便地区的人，往往需要更长时间才能到达医院。
items.en: Residents of areas with poor transport links often take longer to reach hospitals.
answers: Residents of areas with poor transport links often take longer to reach hospitals.
items.notes: with 短语修饰 areas；take longer to do 表示花更长时间做某事。

items.zh: 一条自行车道如果在最繁忙的路口突然中断，就很难构成安全的出行网络。
items.en: A cycle lane that ends abruptly at the busiest junction can hardly form part of a safe travel network.
answers: A cycle lane that ends abruptly at the busiest junction can hardly form part of a safe travel network.
items.notes: that 从句描述具体缺陷；hardly 表示几乎不，语气不是绝对禁止。

items.zh: 拥堵收费收入若用于改善公交服务，公众可能更容易接受这项政策。
items.en: A congestion charge may be more acceptable to the public if its revenue is used to improve bus services.
answers: A congestion charge may be more acceptable to the public if its revenue is used to improve bus services.
items.notes: be acceptable to sb 表示可被接受；if 从句解释接受度的条件。

items.zh: 城市规划的目标不应只是让车辆移动得更快，而应让人们更容易到达目的地。
items.en: The aim of urban planning should be to make destinations easier to reach, rather than merely to make vehicles move faster.
answers: The aim of urban planning should be to make destinations easier to reach, rather than merely to make vehicles move faster.
items.notes: 两个不定式短语比较目标；make vehicles move 中 move 用原形。

items.zh: 由于租约不稳定，一些家庭不得不频繁搬家，打乱孩子的学习。
items.en: Because their tenancies are insecure, some families have to move frequently, disrupting their children's education.
answers: Because their tenancies are insecure, some families have to move frequently, disrupting their children's education.
items.notes: because 交代原因；disrupting 描述频繁搬家的后果。

items.zh: 保留旧城区的特色，并不意味着每一栋旧建筑都必须原封不动。
items.en: Preserving the character of an old district does not mean that every old building must remain unchanged.
answers: Preserving the character of an old district does not mean that every old building must remain unchanged.
items.notes: does not mean that 限制推论；remain + 形容词表示保持状态。

items.zh: 如果交通票价更容易负担，低收入居民就可能有更多工作可选。
items.en: Were fares more affordable, low-income residents might have access to a wider range of jobs.
answers: Were fares more affordable, low-income residents might have access to a wider range of jobs.
items.notes: were 前置构成无 if 的虚拟条件；a wider range of 表示更广的选择范围。

items.zh: 真正让公园发挥作用的，是居民能够安全、方便地使用它。
items.en: What makes a park useful is residents' ability to use it safely and conveniently.
answers: What makes a park useful is residents' ability to use it safely and conveniently.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；ability to do 表示实际使用能力。

items.zh: 学校附近的限速措施既能改善安全，也能让家长更愿意让孩子步行上学。
items.en: Lower speed limits near schools can both improve safety and encourage parents to let their children walk to school.
answers: Lower speed limits near schools can both improve safety and encourage parents to let their children walk to school.
items.notes: both improve ... and encourage ... 保持动词平行；let 后用动词原形。

items.zh: 即使市中心不再允许汽车通行，商店仍需要可靠的送货安排。
items.en: Even if cars are no longer allowed in the city centre, shops still need reliable delivery arrangements.
answers: Even if cars are no longer allowed in the city centre, shops still need reliable delivery arrangements.
items.notes: even if 引导让步条件；区分私人出行限制与货物配送需求。

items.zh: 城市越向外扩张，为每个居民提供基础设施的成本就可能越高。
items.en: The further a city spreads out, the more costly it may become to provide infrastructure for each resident.
answers: The further a city spreads out, the more costly it may become to provide infrastructure for each resident.
items.notes: the + 比较级 ... the + 比较级表示相关变化；it 为形式主语。

items.zh: 废弃工业用地经过治理后，可以为住房建设提供空间，减少对郊野土地的占用。
items.en: Once contaminated industrial sites have been cleaned up, they can accommodate housing and reduce pressure on undeveloped land.
answers: Once contaminated industrial sites have been cleaned up, they can accommodate housing and reduce pressure on undeveloped land.
items.notes: once 从句使用现在完成时被动语态；accommodate 在此表示容纳。

items.zh: 在新线路开通之前，居民就应获知票价和换乘安排。
items.en: Before a new route opens, residents should be informed about fares and transfer arrangements.
answers: Before a new route opens, residents should be informed about fares and transfer arrangements.
items.notes: before 说明沟通时点；inform sb about sth 的被动形式为 be informed about。

items.zh: 如果当初把排水能力纳入设计，这个地下通道也许就不会如此容易积水。
items.en: Had drainage capacity been considered in the design, the underpass might not have flooded so easily.
answers: Had drainage capacity been considered in the design, the underpass might not have flooded so easily.
items.notes: had 前置构成过去虚拟条件倒装；主句 might not have done 表示推测性反思。

items.zh: 高楼可以容纳更多住户；然而，如果公共空间不足，居住密度增加也可能降低生活质量。
items.en: Tall buildings can house more residents; however, greater density may reduce quality of life if public space is inadequate.
answers: Tall buildings can house more residents; however, greater density may reduce quality of life if public space is inadequate.
items.notes: house 在此作动词；however 前用分号，if 从句限定负面结果。

items.zh: 无论居民使用哪种交通方式，路口设计都应考虑行动较慢的人。
items.en: Whichever mode of transport residents use, junction design should account for people who move more slowly.
answers: Whichever mode of transport residents use, junction design should account for people who move more slowly.
items.notes: whichever 引导让步；account for 在此表示把某因素考虑在内。

items.zh: 把商店和诊所建在住宅附近，可以减少居民处理日常事务所需的出行。
items.en: Locating shops and clinics near homes can reduce the journeys residents need for everyday tasks.
answers: Locating shops and clinics near homes can reduce the journeys residents need for everyday tasks.
items.notes: locate 作动词表示把设施设在某处。

items.zh: 社区密度过低时，频繁的公交服务可能难以维持。
items.en: Frequent bus services may be difficult to sustain where residential density is very low.
answers: Frequent bus services may be difficult to sustain where residential density is very low.
items.notes: where 引出具有特定条件的地区。

items.zh: 高密度开发若缺乏学校配套，可能迫使儿童跨越更远的距离上学。
items.en: High-density development without adequate schools may force children to travel further for education.
answers: High-density development without adequate schools may force children to travel further for education.
items.notes: force sb to do：迫使某人做事。

items.zh: 规划者需要了解居民实际走的路线，而不是只依赖地图上的最短路径。
items.en: Planners need to understand the routes people actually take rather than rely solely on the shortest lines on a map.
answers: Planners need to understand the routes people actually take rather than rely solely on the shortest lines on a map.
items.notes: 定语从句省略宾语关系代词。

items.zh: 地下通道虽然分开了人车交通，却可能让轮椅使用者绕行很远。
items.en: Underpasses separate pedestrians from vehicles but may impose long detours on wheelchair users.
answers: Underpasses separate pedestrians from vehicles but may impose long detours on wheelchair users.
items.notes: impose sth on sb：使某人承担。

items.zh: 连续的遮雨设施能让步行在恶劣天气中也更可行。
items.en: Continuous shelter can make walking a more viable option in poor weather.
answers: Continuous shelter can make walking a more viable option in poor weather.
items.notes: make A B：使 A 成为 B。

items.zh: 路边摊提供便利和生计，因此治理时需要兼顾通行空间与经营需求。
items.en: Street stalls provide convenience and livelihoods, so regulation must consider both pedestrian space and traders' needs.
answers: Street stalls provide convenience and livelihoods, so regulation must consider both pedestrian space and traders' needs.
items.notes: both A and B 表达两方面需要。

items.zh: 夜间经济需要可靠的交通与卫生服务，而不仅是延长营业时间。
items.en: A night-time economy needs reliable transport and sanitation, not simply longer opening hours.
answers: A night-time economy needs reliable transport and sanitation, not simply longer opening hours.
items.notes: sanitation：公共卫生及清洁服务。

items.zh: 把停车位改成户外座椅，可能增加街道停留空间，但也需要照顾装卸需求。
items.en: Converting parking spaces into outdoor seating can create room to linger, though loading needs must also be accommodated.
answers: Converting parking spaces into outdoor seating can create room to linger, though loading needs must also be accommodated.
items.notes: convert A into B：改变用途。

items.zh: 货运集中在高峰时段，会加重原本紧张的道路负担。
items.en: Deliveries concentrated during peak hours place additional pressure on already crowded roads.
answers: Deliveries concentrated during peak hours place additional pressure on already crowded roads.
items.notes: place pressure on：给某对象增加压力。

items.zh: 在居民区推广夜间配送之前，应评估噪声会如何影响睡眠。
items.en: Before encouraging overnight deliveries in residential areas, authorities should assess their effects on sleep.
answers: Before encouraging overnight deliveries in residential areas, authorities should assess their effects on sleep.
items.notes: overnight 在此表示夜间进行。

items.zh: 共享配送点可以减少重复停车，却可能把取件成本转嫁给居民。
items.en: Shared delivery points can reduce repeated stops while shifting collection costs onto residents.
answers: Shared delivery points can reduce repeated stops while shifting collection costs onto residents.
items.notes: shift costs onto：把成本转嫁给。

items.zh: 出租车数量增加并不一定改善服务，尤其是在司机集中于少数热门地区时。
items.en: More taxis do not necessarily improve service, particularly when drivers cluster in a few popular areas.
answers: More taxis do not necessarily improve service, particularly when drivers cluster in a few popular areas.
More taxis don't necessarily improve service, particularly when drivers cluster in a few popular areas.
items.notes: cluster：聚集；not necessarily 限定推论。

items.zh: 公交优先信号能提高可靠性，而无需给每条道路都增加车道。
items.en: Traffic signals that prioritise buses can improve reliability without adding lanes to every road.
answers: Traffic signals that prioritise buses can improve reliability without adding lanes to every road.
items.notes: prioritise：给予优先。

items.zh: 换乘距离太长，可能抵消线路覆盖范围扩大的好处。
items.en: Long transfer distances may cancel out the benefits of a wider transport network.
answers: Long transfer distances may cancel out the benefits of a wider transport network.
items.notes: cancel out：抵消。

items.zh: 如果票价制度过于复杂，偶尔乘车的人可能难以判断哪张票最划算。
items.en: Occasional passengers may struggle to identify the best-value ticket if fare structures are too complicated.
answers: Occasional passengers may struggle to identify the best-value ticket if fare structures are too complicated.
items.notes: best-value：性价比最高的。

items.zh: 可靠的实时信息能减轻等车的不确定感，但不能代替实际的准点服务。
items.en: Reliable real-time information reduces uncertainty while waiting, but it cannot replace punctual services.
answers: Reliable real-time information reduces uncertainty while waiting, but it cannot replace punctual services.
Reliable real-time information reduces uncertainty while waiting, but it can't replace punctual services.
items.notes: replace：代替；区分信息与实际服务。

items.zh: 将自行车带上列车，可以扩大车站覆盖范围，却也占用车厢空间。
items.en: Allowing bicycles on trains can extend station catchment areas while taking up space on board.
answers: Allowing bicycles on trains can extend station catchment areas while taking up space on board.
items.notes: take up space：占用空间。

items.zh: 自行车停车设施如果缺乏防盗措施，人们可能仍不愿骑车通勤。
items.en: People may still avoid cycling to work if bicycle parking offers little protection against theft.
answers: People may still avoid cycling to work if bicycle parking offers little protection against theft.
items.notes: protection against：防范某风险。

items.zh: 限速标准需要通过道路设计得到支持，否则司机可能难以改变习惯。
items.en: Speed limits need support from road design; otherwise, drivers may be slow to change their habits.
answers: Speed limits need support from road design; otherwise, drivers may be slow to change their habits.
items.notes: be slow to do：迟迟未改变。

items.zh: 新地铁线路带来的地价上涨，可能让原有居民无力继续居住。
items.en: Land price increases associated with a new metro line may price existing residents out of the area.
answers: Land price increases associated with a new metro line may price existing residents out of the area.
items.notes: price sb out of：使某人负担不起。

items.zh: 保障性住房应接近日常服务，而不是被集中安排在城市边缘。
items.en: Affordable housing should be close to everyday services rather than concentrated on the urban fringe.
answers: Affordable housing should be close to everyday services rather than concentrated on the urban fringe.
items.notes: urban fringe：城市边缘地区。

items.zh: 租金管制的影响需要结合新增住房供应和维修投入一起评估。
items.en: The effects of rent controls need to be evaluated alongside new housing supply and investment in maintenance.
answers: The effects of rent controls need to be evaluated alongside new housing supply and investment in maintenance.
items.notes: alongside 表示一并考虑。

items.zh: 空置税是否有效，取决于政府能否准确识别长期无人使用的住房。
items.en: The effectiveness of a vacancy tax depends on accurate identification of homes left unused for long periods.
answers: The effectiveness of a vacancy tax depends on accurate identification of homes left unused for long periods.
items.notes: left unused 为过去分词短语。

items.zh: 住宅面积变小可以降低部分成本，但不能忽视采光和通风。
items.en: Smaller homes can reduce some costs, but daylight and ventilation must not be neglected.
answers: Smaller homes can reduce some costs, but daylight and ventilation must not be neglected.
items.notes: must not be done：不可被忽视。

items.zh: 改造旧楼时，保留住户的邻里联系也应成为一个目标。
items.en: Preserving residents' neighbourhood ties should be an objective when older buildings are renovated.
answers: Preserving residents' neighbourhood ties should be an objective when older buildings are renovated.
items.notes: when 从句交代适用情境。

items.zh: 临时安置如果距离工作地点太远，就可能增加重建期间的生活压力。
items.en: Temporary accommodation far from workplaces can add to the pressures of living through reconstruction.
answers: Temporary accommodation far from workplaces can add to the pressures of living through reconstruction.
items.notes: add to：增加已有负担。

items.zh: 城市中的闲置地可以暂时用于社区花园，但使用期限应提前说明。
items.en: Vacant urban land can temporarily host community gardens, provided the duration of use is made clear in advance.
answers: Vacant urban land can temporarily host community gardens, provided the duration of use is made clear in advance.
items.notes: provided 引导条件从句。

items.zh: 儿童需要能自主到达的游玩空间，而不只是由家长开车接送的设施。
items.en: Children need play spaces they can reach independently, not just facilities requiring a parent to drive them.
answers: Children need play spaces they can reach independently, not just facilities requiring a parent to drive them.
items.notes: requiring 是分词定语。

items.zh: 公共厕所的缺乏会限制一些老年人和照护者外出的时间。
items.en: A shortage of public toilets can limit how long some older people and carers spend away from home.
answers: A shortage of public toilets can limit how long some older people and carers spend away from home.
items.notes: how long 从句作 limit 的宾语。

items.zh: 长椅不仅提供休息地点，也可能让行动较慢的人愿意走得更远。
items.en: Benches offer rest and may also enable slower walkers to travel further on foot.
answers: Benches offer rest and may also enable slower walkers to travel further on foot.
items.notes: enable sb to do：使某人能够。

items.zh: 把所有公园都建在新城区，可能让老城区居民持续缺少绿地。
items.en: Building parks only in new districts may leave older neighbourhoods persistently short of green space.
answers: Building parks only in new districts may leave older neighbourhoods persistently short of green space.
items.notes: leave + 宾语 + 形容词短语。

items.zh: 洪水治理需要跨地区协调，因为一地加快排水可能增加另一地的风险。
items.en: Flood management needs coordination across districts, since faster drainage in one place may raise risks elsewhere.
answers: Flood management needs coordination across districts, since faster drainage in one place may raise risks elsewhere.
items.notes: elsewhere：在别处。

items.zh: 在热浪中，遮阴不足的公交站可能对长期候车的人造成额外负担。
items.en: During heatwaves, bus stops with little shade may place extra strain on people waiting for long periods.
answers: During heatwaves, bus stops with little shade may place extra strain on people waiting for long periods.
items.notes: place strain on：给人增加负担。

items.zh: 透水铺装可以帮助雨水渗入地下，但需要持续维护才能保持效果。
items.en: Permeable paving can allow rainwater to soak into the ground, though continued maintenance is needed to preserve its effectiveness.
answers: Permeable paving can allow rainwater to soak into the ground, though continued maintenance is needed to preserve its effectiveness.
items.notes: soak into：渗入。

items.zh: 施工信息提前公布，可以让商户为临时客流变化做好准备。
items.en: Advance notice of construction can help businesses prepare for temporary changes in customer traffic.
answers: Advance notice of construction can help businesses prepare for temporary changes in customer traffic.
items.notes: prepare for：为某事做准备。

items.zh: 短期试行街道改造，能在永久施工之前暴露一些实际问题。
items.en: Temporary street redesigns can reveal practical problems before permanent construction begins.
answers: Temporary street redesigns can reveal practical problems before permanent construction begins.
items.notes: reveal：揭示尚未发现的问题。

items.zh: 地图上的服务半径，未必反映居民跨越铁路或河流时面临的障碍。
items.en: Service radii on maps may fail to reflect barriers created by railway lines or rivers.
answers: Service radii on maps may fail to reflect barriers created by railway lines or rivers.
items.notes: radii 是 radius 的复数。

items.zh: 城市与周边乡镇共享交通规划，有助于解决跨行政边界的通勤问题。
items.en: Joint transport planning between cities and nearby towns can address commuting across administrative borders.
answers: Joint transport planning between cities and nearby towns can address commuting across administrative borders.
items.notes: joint planning：联合规划。

items.zh: 规划决策一旦锁定基础设施布局，后续纠正错误可能代价高昂。
items.en: Once planning decisions lock in infrastructure layouts, correcting mistakes later can be expensive.
answers: Once planning decisions lock in infrastructure layouts, correcting mistakes later can be expensive.
items.notes: lock in：固定下来，难以改变。
